snippet.title: 'if you stay' official game trailer
snippet.description:
A free yuri visual novel based on the PC-98 aesthetic. Made by YukimiSoft.

STORY
Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together. 

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/44...
ITCH:IO: https://yukimisoft.itch.io/if-you-stay
